description:
PROBLEM: the CI lint job (271-410 s) runs four full-suite pytest --collect-only passes per PR: `make lint-markers` (Makefile ~line 500: one collection, 94-126 s CI, cold assertion rewriting) and `_project/scripts/fast_lane_ceiling_check.py --strict` (one collection per forbidden marker expression in `_project/config/fast_test_lane_policy.json`: resource_heavy, stress, live_integration; 67-96 s CI). Local: cold collection 45.0 s vs 14.5 s with --assert=plain; warm 13 s vs 11 s. Assertion rewriting does nothing for --collect-only. One collection can answer every -m expression (pytest evaluates -m per collected item after collection).

CHANGE: L1 run the lint-markers collection with --assert=plain (prior art: PR #3253 for medium-collect). L2 make the fast-lane guard evaluate all forbidden expressions (and path substrings) against one collection, sharing L1's collection pass so the lint job collects once.
